title: dryopteris nitidula
intro: Dryopteris nitidula, commonly known as the glossy wood fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, fever, and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris nitidula include its ability to cool the body, relieve heat, and alleviate headaches and other symptoms associated with fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
